values.note: $20 a night per single site including 1 vehicle; $10 per additional vehicle (paid to the host on arrival); $6 day-use fee. Firewood $7 a bundle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night', '$20.00 includes 1 driving vehicle', '$10 each additional vehicle', '$6 day use campground fee', 'Firewood: Yes- $7.00 / bundle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232770/rates (2026 Peak Season 05-22 to 09-10 and First-come seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('1/2 price fees for Interagency Senior and Access Pass holders'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 232770 (catx.py: all 29 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 30 sites, max trailer length 40 ft. recreation.gov lists 29 units with max vehicle lengths of 24-45 ft (most 27-36). Back-in spurs are medium length; 3 accessible sites.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('Camp sites: 30', 'Max Trailer Length: 40 feet', 'Accessible Facilities: Toilet 3 sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232770 ('Back-in spurs are medium length') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Max Vehicle Length 24-45), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water from hand pumps. Bear-resistant dumpster and food-storage lockers; on-site host sells firewood.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232770 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided', amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Food Storage Locker', 'Firewood Vender') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('Potable water is available at this site', 'Bear resistant dumpster located on site', 'Host : Yes'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service 'Seasons of Use: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. Weather Dependent.' recreation.gov also sells first-come nights into late September.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('Seasons of Use Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day. Weather Dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232770 (notice 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 25 of 29 recreation.gov units reservable; the rest are first-come and must be booked in person on site. Reservations close 2 days before arrival; a late arrival is not a no-show until 24 hours after check-in time. 16-day maximum stay in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds. Concessionaire-run (Recreation Resource Management of America).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232770 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 2; notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'Late Arrivals: campers are not considered a "no-show" until 24 hours after arrival date check in time') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (25 reservable, 4 not) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/basin-campground ('Reservations can be made at recreation.gov', 'There is a 16 day maximum stay in all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds', 'Contact Name: Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA)'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD) campground on the banks of the West Fork of Rock Creek, ~7 mi W of Red Lodge on paved Forest Road 2071 (distinct from adjacent Cascade CG). Burned in the 2008 Cascade Fire, so the setting is open and full of wildflowers; Basin Lakes trailhead across the road, Wild Bill Lake nearby. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run (RRMA) for the Forest Service; reservable on recreation.gov with a few first-come sites. Confirmed $20 (2026), no electric, 30 sites, vault toilets, drinking water, senior/access half price. Changed max_rig_ft 30->40 (FS 'Max Trailer Length: 40 feet'), max stay 10->16, cleared the calendar-derived closes 09-10 (FS: Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day); added some FCFS, 2-day cutoff. Not stated: booking window (inherited 180). Note trimmed and the 10-day limit dropped.
